Card Size | 63x88mm |} '''Reflections: A Collector's Bounty''' (sold as '''Reflections''') is the 23rd Star Wars CCG product, published by Decipher in January 2000. It is 114 foil cards (57 per side): 87 very rare foils, 25 super rare foils, and 2 ultra rare foils ([[Darth Vader]] and [[Luke Skywalker]]). Displays shipped with oversized, non-playable objective box toppers. Packs are 18 cards, MSRP $4.95, 30 packs per box. Each pack has '''one foil''' from the list below plus random reprints from earlier expansions. Those reprints are not listed here. A foil of a title not on this list is not a Reflections pack foil. It may be a later [[Promotional Foils|promotional foil]], a Japanese foil, or a counterfeit.[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]. {{Set infobox |name=Premiere Limited |image=Premiere-Limited-box-encyc.png |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[:Category:Decipher sets|Decipher]] (1995–2001) |released=December 1995 |cards=324 (162 Light, 162 Dark) |next=[[A New Hope Limited]] |related=[[Premiere Two-Player Introductory Game]] }} '''Premiere Limited''' is the 1st expansion of Star Wars CCG, published by Decipher in December 1995.[https://web.archive.org/web/19990504174938/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/productlibrary/thecollection/index.html Star Wars CCG: The Expansions], Decipher (Wayback, 4 May 1999) It is the base set: 324 cards (162 Light Side and 162 Dark Side), 108 of each rarity.[https://web.archive.org/web/20020611184117/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/premiere/light/index.html Premiere Light Side card list], Decipher (Wayback, 11 June 2002)[https://web.archive.org/web/20020611184117/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/premiere/dark/index.html Premiere Dark Side card list], Decipher (Wayback, 11 June 2002)[https://web.archive.org/web/20070928014432/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/swallcards.pdf Complete Card List], Decipher PDF (Wayback, 28 September 2007) Black border. It introduced many of the principal characters from ''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'', but not [[Chewbacca]], [[R2-D2 (Artoo-Detoo)|R2-D2]], or the Death Star as a system. Those arrived in later products. The related [[Premiere Two-Player Introductory Game]] followed in February 1996. Limited went out of print in April 1996 when [[Premiere Unlimited]] (white border) replaced it.[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive] (8 October 2026).[https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Premiere_Limited Premiere Limited] at Wookieepedia.
